applicabilityBasis.summary: cgUSD is documented as a dollar-targeted, Treasury-backed rebasing token on Base with minting and redemption in USDC. Its token and overview pages describe 1:1 USDC redemption, while the withdrawal FAQ permits Treasury-price movements to reduce the claimable amount and quotes a 35-basis-point fee. The interface terms identify Cygnus Finance without naming a legal cgUSD issuer or a national-currency or bank-deposit redemption obligor. The unresolved issuer obligation and inconsistent redemption disclosures support unclear applicability under GENIUS section 2(22); neither yield accrual nor USDC redemption establishes a categorical exclusion.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. No exact legal cgUSD issuer or issuer domicile is assigned. Cygnus Information Limited appears in the website footer, GLEIF corporate record and the separate CGN whitepaper, which do not establish that it issues cgUSD or owes holders redemption. ARKS publishes a subsidiary MSB-registration claim; no prudential cgUSD license is inferred. The withdrawal FAQ states 5-7 days, a 35-basis-point fee and possible claim reduction; the separate redemption page states 2-5 days with an early-promotion fee waiver. Their publication chronology is not established. Conceptual Treasury collateral documentation does not verify actual holdings or a current reserve report. No public 1:1 national-currency issuer redemption policy or current monthly independent reserve attestation was verified, so the corresponding optional presence fields are omitted. Unknown pathway and foreign-exception fields do not assert authorization or rejection. DASP posture refers to the GENIUS statutory timetable, not unconditional permission under other laws.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the reopened OCC pending digital-asset bank-charter table, OCC proposal, Federal Register SCRC procedure, Federal Reserve proposal, NYDFS directory and token documents, together with token/entity-specific official-domain searches, did not identify a qualifying public GENIUS issuer approval, state qualification, pending GENIUS application or registered foreign exception for this token. The OCC table is not an exhaustive GENIUS issuer register; general rulemaking and ordinary licenses are not token-specific authorization. This bounded public-evidence finding does not exclude confidential or unpublished filings.
